title: Siege of Noda Castle
text: The siege of Noda Castle (野田城の戦い) took place from January to February 1573, between the forces of the Takeda clan, led by Takeda Shingen, against the Tokugawa clan, led by Tokugawa Ieyasu. Along with the Battle of Mikatagahara, it was one of the final battles of Takeda Shingen's career.
